name: Notus React
summary: Free Tailwind CSS and React UI kit with 120+ coded elements and a pre-built admin dashboard.
description: Open-source UI kit and admin template built with React and Tailwind CSS. Provides 120+ coded CSS elements and 18 dynamic React components (navbars, modals, tabs, dropdowns, alerts, tooltips), plus ready pages for a landing presentation, a profile and an admin dashboard with tables, maps and login/register screens.
contains: 120+ coded CSS elements incl. alerts, buttons and inputs
18 dynamic React components incl. navbars, modals, tabs and dropdowns
pages: landing presentation, profile, dashboard, settings, tables, maps, login and register
